name: Hotel Le Negresco
insider_take: Belle époque glamour meets modern luxury on the legendary Promenade des Anglais, where pink-domed elegance has welcomed royalty and celebrities for over a century.
whats_special: This iconic palace hotel features the world's largest private art collection in a hotel, including original Picassos and Salvador Dalí sculptures. The famous pink dome, topped with a Gustave Eiffel-designed cupola, has been a Nice landmark since 1913. Each of the 117 rooms is uniquely decorated with priceless antiques and original artwork.
pro_tip: Book the Salon Royal suite where The Beatles once stayed, or dine at La Petite Maison across the street – a favorite of Elton John and other A-listers who frequent the Negresco.
dont_miss: The hotel's two Michelin-starred Chantecler restaurant and the whimsical Carousel Bar with its authentic 1913 merry-go-round horses. Take the 5-minute stroll to Place Masséna's dancing fountains, or explore the nearby Old Town's vibrant Cours Saleya flower market.
pros: Iconic Belle Époque palace hotel with unparalleled French Riviera heritage
Prime Promenade des Anglais location with stunning Mediterranean views
World-class art collection and museum-quality interiors throughout property
Michelin-starred dining and exceptional culinary experiences
Legendary service standards befitting a Leading Hotels property
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Historic building may have traditional room configurations
